role: Vendored third-party Syzygy tablebase probing library (Step 5.2)

license.notice: third_party/fathom/LICENSE is preserved verbatim; per-file notices in the vendored sources are unmodified.
license.compatibility: MIT is compatible with Manta's GPL-3.0-or-later distribution.

policy.authorized_by: PLAN.md source-exception clause: Fathom is the anticipated third-party source exception for Syzygy.
policy.scope: Probe and format layer only. The typed WDL/DTZ contract, score conversion, rule-50 policy, root filtering and interior search policy remain original Manta Zig.
policy.update_procedure: Changing the pinned commit requires re-recording every hash below, re-running the deterministic gates, and an ADR amendment. The revision never moves silently.
policy.byte_fidelity: Files are stored exactly as published upstream with LF endings. '.gitattributes' marks 'third_party/** -text' so no line-ending normalization can alter them; without that rule a core.autocrlf checkout rewrites the bytes and invalidates every sha256 below.

excluded.apps/: Standalone CLI driver; not part of the engine build.
excluded.Makefile: Upstream build driver; Manta owns its own build.zig integration.
excluded.README.md: Not required for license compliance or the build.
